clips.title: The story
paras: In Cathedral Square, Orphan Matron Nightingale cares for Stormwind’s orphaned children. She and Matron Shellene give them shelter and guidance, and invite Alliance adventurers to spend Children's Week with them.

Outside the orphanage, south-east of the Cathedral of Light, Orphan Matron Nightingale cares for Stormwind’s most vulnerable children. Recent wars, gnoll attacks, and the rise of the Defias Brotherhood have left many without homes or parents. Nightingale and Matron Shellene give them shelter, basic care, and guidance under the Church of the Holy Light’s watch.

Matron Nightingale believes children need hope as well as food and shelter. Each Children's Week, she asks Alliance heroes to take an orphan on journeys across Azeroth. She hopes meeting celebrated champions will build their confidence, show them the wider world beyond the city walls, and remind them they are not forgotten.
